{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Select only the two columns we need
subset = penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']]

# Drop rows with missing values
complete_cases = subset.dropna()

# Compute the correlation
correlation = complete_cases['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_cases['body_mass_g'])

# Print the result
print(correlation)"}
